name: Pixel Base
description: An isometric pixel-art virtual office for your AI agents. Every agent running in Orca becomes a little office worker: it sits at a desk while it works, raises a ? when it waits for you, shouts ! when it is blocked and wanders to the lounge when it is idle. Click a character to see its profile, focus its terminal or open its workspace.
